title: RTEC EEO and Diversity Strategic Action Plan — FY2010 and Beyond
mission_statement: Make transportation affordable, available, and accessible to everyone living in the stated 18-county service area.
primary_goals: Eradicate discrimination in the workplace by enforcing equal-employment-opportunity laws, regulations and policies.
Promote inclusion and diversity at all levels of the workforce.
Empower individuals by promoting constructive conflict management so they can participate fully in RTEC's mission.
Use communications to demonstrate RTEC's commitment to EEO and diversity.
operational_objectives: Timely/effective discrimination complaint processing and resolution.
Internal tracking, program measures and performance measures.
Workforce analysis for underrepresentation and barrier identification.
Recruitment, retention and development of a diverse workforce.
Conflict prevention/resolution, mediation and trend analysis.
Recurring EEO/diversity/conflict-prevention training for managers and employees.
Annual EEO/diversity policy issuance and broader communication/outreach.
recurring_measurement_ideas: Quarterly data audits for tracking-system accuracy.
Timeliness/quality of workforce analyses and mandated reports.
Periodic review of communications and employee feedback.
useful_durable_design_principles: EEO/compliance work should be measured with explicit service/process metrics rather than treated only as document production.
Complaint, accommodation, workforce-analysis, training and conflict-management data should be tracked separately but synthesized for program evaluation.
Managers should receive recurring policy/training reinforcement, and policies should be reissued on a defined schedule.
Barrier analysis should connect workforce data to concrete corrective-action recommendations.

source_authority_warning.finding: The plan contains extensive federal-agency-specific terminology and procedures, including 29 CFR Part 1614, EEOC 462 reports, No FEAR Act, MD-110, Office of Shared Services SLAs, SF-256, Federal Employee language and Section 508 complaint references.
source_authority_warning.interpretation: These passages appear adapted from federal-agency/model material and must not be treated as proof that every cited federal-sector procedure/report applied to RTEC.
source_authority_warning.rule: Promote only RTEC-specific practices that are corroborated by RTEC plans/policies, actual records or current user confirmation. Keep the remainder as historical/reference design material.

related_training_evidence.observation: A January 4, 2011 memorandum schedules a 35-40 minute EEO training session for RTEC managers on January 11, 2011, corroborating that manager EEO training was an actual historical practice.
